items.text:
Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

1. Kamil (24) – agresywny socjopata i patologiczny kłamca z przeszłością w poprawczaku, mocno zadłużony. Silny, na dopalaczach, bezwzględne spojrzenie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY 
Daty: 10.08 i 11.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

2. Adrian (27) – Interesuje się strzelectwem, jest instruktorem na strzelnicy. Zostaje postrzelony przez kolegę, gdy próbuje obezwładnić go podczas włamania.
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Dominik (28) – prowadzi spółkę zajmującą się kompleksowym montażem nowoczesnych instalacji elektrycznych, alarmów i monitoringu. Zostaje pobity. Średniej budowy ciała, nie jest silny fizycznie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4. Pracownik 2 (28) – pracownik budowlany
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

5. Sebastian (30) – prowadzi komis, karany w przeszłości za kradzieże. Skupuje kradziony sprzęt.
Data: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

6. Pracownik 1 (37) – pracownik budowlany 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

7. Konrad (39) – brat Artura. Nieporadny, z bardzo niską samooceną, wiecznie gnębiony przez brata i niedoceniany przez rodziców. Przez całe życie gromadził w sobie żal i gniew. Wysoki, szczupły, dłuższe włosy.
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Daty: 12.08 i 14.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

8. Biznesmen (45) – elegancko ubrany mężczyzna, zostaje napadnięty na ulicy. 
Daty: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9. Właściciel (48) – przedsiębiorca budowlany. Zawiadamia policję o zaginięciu pracowników i pomaga w identyfikacji. 
Daty: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Za każdą wyjątkową restauracją stoi wyjątkowy człowiek…
Szukamy restauratorów z całej Polski do nowego programu TV! 📺🍽️

Bo najlepsze jedzenie to dopiero początek…

Chcemy poznać ludzi, którzy stworzyli niesamowite miejsca z prawdziwą duszą. Restauracje, w których liczy się nie tylko to, co trafia na talerz, ale też historia, emocje, atmosfera i ludzie, którzy ją tworzą. ❤️

Szukamy wyjątkowych miejsc:

✨ restauracji z charakterem i niepowtarzalnym klimatem

✨ rodzinnych biznesów tworzonych z sercem

✨ kulinarnych perełek ukrytych w całej Polsce

✨ lokali, które mają swoją historię 

✨ właścicieli, dla których gotowanie i goszczenie ludzi to prawdziwa pasja

Czy goście przychodzą do Was nie tylko dla jedzenia, ale też dla atmosfery, którą stworzyliście?

Czy za Waszym miejscem stoi historia, którą warto opowiedzieć całej Polsce?

📩 Napisz do nas zgloszenia@rochstar.tv - w załączniku dodaj krótką wideowizytowkę i opis Twojej restauracji :)

items.text:
🎬 Wellness Wednesday

Acting isn’t just lines—it’s taking care of the person behind the performance.

Long hours, tough auditions, and the waiting game can test your mindset.

That’s why I train my body, strengthen my mind, and protect my peace.

Every workout builds stamina for set life.
Every healthy meal fuels my performance.
Every moment of gratitude keeps me grounded beyond the booking.

I show up ready—because when opportunity comes, I want to meet it at my best.

Stronger inside and out. 🎥✨

#WellnessWednesday #ActorLife #ActressLife #FilmActor #ModelLife #OnSetReady #AuditionLife #MindsetMatters #LouisianaActor

Every healthy meal fuels my performance.
Every moment of gratitude keeps me grounded beyond the booking.

I show up ready—because when opportunity comes, I want to meet it at my best.

Stronger inside and out. 🎥✨

#WellnessWednesday #ActorLife #ActressLife #FilmActor #ModelLife #OnSetReady #AuditionLife #MindsetMatters #LouisianaActor

Pierwsze osoby są już z nami — czas na Ciebie.

Jeśli scena i plan filmowy to miejsca, w których czujesz się sobą — zapraszamy.
Rekrutacja trwa.

Do wyboru:
🎭 grupa przygotowująca
🎬 grupa otwarta
🎥 grupa zaawansowana
🎶 grupa teatru muzycznego

W nowym sezonie rozwijamy program —
nowe rodzaje zajęć, świeże podejście i nowa energia w zespole.

Jak dołączyć?
• wejdź na: www.aktorska.warszawa.pl
• pobierz formularz zgłoszeniowy

Nie odkładaj siebie na później.

**WARSZAWA **

**serial fabularny - STAND INI **

**stawka: 160 zł**

Do serialu fabularnego szukam STAND INA i STAND INKI.

**Stand in** to osoba zastępująca aktora podczas przygotowań technicznych takich jak np. ustawianie oświetlenia czy kadrowanie kamer.
* **STAND IN'KA** - kobieta ok. 20-35 lat, wzrost ok. 166 cm, rozmiar XS, włosy dłuższe ciemny blond.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

* **STAND IN **- mężczyzna ok. 20-40 lat, wzrost ok. 183 cm, klatka ok.104 cm, rozmiar L, brunet, włosy dłuższe. Nie długie. Klasyczna fryzura.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3, 6, 8, 10 i 11 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **STAND IN**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość i wymiary: wzrost, klatka/biust, pas, rozmiar ubrania i buta

W załączniku: **zdjęcie twarzy - selfie z dnia zgłoszenia i aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki**

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka.

CASTING CALL

We're looking for two performers to join our DICK WHITTINGTON pantomime (school tour).  
Running from 30th November - 18th December 2026 + some January dates TBC.

We’re casting any of the following parts, with our existing performers playing the opposite roles. All ages and ethnicities welcome to apply.

- Dick Whittington (lead,  M or F)
- Tiddles the Cat (comic,  M or F)
- Mayor Dratt  (villain,  M only)
- Alice Fitzwarren (love interest,  F only)

Because we perform in schools, the shows are weekday mornings and early afternoons, so you'll have your evenings and weekends free. The performances are in the Norfolk, Suffolk and Cambridge area. 

We’re currently offering a minimum of £1050 - which will go up as we get more bookings in + travel expenses. 
Aiming to start a mix of Wednesday & Thursday weekly rehearsals from September - in HUNSTANTON (PE36).
Whilst rehearsals are unpaid,  any unused travel expenses from the tour will be shared amongst the cast at the end. 

This will be our fourteenth panto tour, and we've built up a good name in the area, with schools booking us year after year (even before we announce the title!) We pride ourselves on being a warm, friendly, but professional company.

If interested, please get in touch for further details - either by a PM on here, or via email - purple-dreams@hotmail.co.uk - I’m looking forward to hearing from (some) of you. 🙂

Many thanks
Tobias Nicholls
Creative Director 
Purple Dreams Productions

sharedPost.text:
🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Sergiu Ardelean über AR und das Beleben durch Narrative. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 173. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 11.08.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten. 

©Congerdesign 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/7MvGL7qkB  

#KunstUndWirtschaft #KulturUndWirtschaft #Kulturmanagement #Kreativwirtschaft

Hi all!  Here's a job opp for anyone in the group who is free for a few hours on July 30th, in the 40+ age range, and want to make some quick money - 

**CASTING CALL: Actors/Servers Needed for July 30th Event**

I’m seeking **five experienced servers** for a low-budget, filmed dinner event at a restaurant location in Simi Valley on July 30th. 

This is a great opportunity for either:
* experienced event servers who are comfortable on camera OR 
* performance-forward actors who are also comfortable serving

**Date:** Thursday, July 30

**Time:** 5:00 PM – 9:30 / 10:00 PM

**Location:** Simi Valley, CA

**Age:** 40+ older

**Pay**: $250

**Responsibilities will include:**
* Serving plated food from the restaurant

# 🎭 URGENT CASTING CALL – ORIS

Unfortunately, due to unforeseen circumstances, we are looking to recast the role of **Oris** in our original musical, **A Place Not Mine**.
**ORIS**

**Male | Playing Age: 18–30**

Oris is one of the main characters in the story. He is charismatic, quick-witted and full of energy, always finding a way to make people laugh. Beneath his humour, however, is someone incredibly loyal, caring and emotionally intelligent. He is the first person to welcome the new student to Novaterra and quickly becomes the heart of the friendship group.

We're looking for an actor who has:
* Strong acting ability.
* Good singing ability.
* Great comic timing.
* Warm, likeable energy and strong ensemble skills.

📍 **Please note:** We are **only considering actors based in London or the surrounding areas**, as regular rehearsals will take place in London.

**Payment:** This is currently an unpaid opportunity. However, should the production secure funding, all cast members will be paid accordingly. 
Audition

If you're interested, simply send us a message on **Instagram**.

If you'd like, you can also include a **self-tape singing any Disney song**. This is **completely optional**, but we'd love to hear your voice if you choose to send one.

We can't wait to hear from you! ✨

📩 **DM us on Instagram:** @a.place.not.mine

Hej! 👋

Pracuję właśnie nad teledyskiem do mojego drugiego singla, który będzie promował moją debiutancką EP-kę 🤍

Mam już gotową koncepcję i masę ciekawych pomysłów (trochę komedii, trochę detektywistycznego klimatu i stalkingu 👀🕵️), ale brakuje mi jednej bardzo ważnej osoby…

🎥 Szukam operatora kamery / osoby, która pomoże mi zrealizować ten teledysk.

📍 Najlepiej Pomorze / Trójmiasto, ale jeśli masz możliwość dojazdu, również chętnie pogadam!

Budżet niestety nie jest hollywoodzki 😅, ale zależy mi na współpracy z kimś kreatywnym, kto chciałby stworzyć coś naprawdę oryginalnego do swojego portfolio. Oczywiście dogadamy wszystkie szczegóły i zrobię wszystko, żeby współpraca była po prostu przyjemna. 🙌

Jeśli znasz kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany albo sam/sama tworzysz wideo, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej! 📩

Będę ogromnie wdzięczny za każde udostępnienie! 🫶🏼

Mam już gotową koncepcję i masę ciekawych pomysłów (trochę komedii, trochę detektywistycznego klimatu i stalkingu 👀🕵️), ale brakuje mi jednej bardzo ważnej osoby…

🎥 Szukam operatora kamery / osoby, która pomoże mi zrealizować ten teledysk.

📍 Najlepiej Pomorze / Trójmiasto, ale jeśli masz możliwość dojazdu, również chętnie pogadam!

Budżet niestety nie jest hollywoodzki 😅, ale zależy mi na współpracy z kimś kreatywnym, kto chciałby stworzyć coś naprawdę oryginalnego do swojego portfolio. Oczywiście dogadamy wszystkie szczegóły i zrobię wszystko, żeby współpraca była po prostu przyjemna. 🙌

Jeśli znasz kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany albo sam/sama tworzysz wideo, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej! 📩

Będę ogromnie wdzięczny za każde udostępnienie! 🫶🏼

**CASTING CALL – PAID + EXPENSES COVERED | GERMANY | SEPTEMBER 2026**

We're casting for **These Little Moments**, a heartfelt coming-of-age drama set in 2002 about four childhood friends reuniting for one final summer road trip before tragedy changes everything.

We're looking for actors **playing ages 20–27** for four lead roles:

**JAMES (20–27)**
The geeky guy who overthinks every move he makes. He has had a secret crush on Emma for ages but never quite had the guts to ask her out, always telling himself he could wait for the right moment. Over the course of the trip, he learns that the right moment doesn't always come, and that if he truly cares about something, he has to act.

**RUBY (20–27)**
The caring leader and enthusiastic glue of the group. She has always loved living in their small town and never questioned it, but lately, watching her friends leave one by one, she has started to doubt the choices she made. Underneath the big energy is someone quietly afraid of being the one left behind.

**EMMA (20–27)**
An optimistic girl who hides her fears behind a smile. She left their hometown young to study fashion, and she still wavers between chasing her dreams and the pull of the life she left behind. Now she has a once-in-a-lifetime chance in front of her, but her own dark thoughts hold her back and leave her yearning for somewhere that feels safe.

**ELIO (20–27)**
The lovable stoner who doesn't have big dreams and is perfectly fine with that. He loves music and looks forward to a simple life running a small CD shop. His laid-back demeanour makes people think he doesn't care, but beneath it, he is devoted to his friends, filming every moment of the holiday because he can't imagine life without them.

 **Shooting:** Germany (Berlin/Brandenburg)
 **Dates:** 8–17 September 2026
 **Language:** English

If you're interested, please send your **CV/showreel**, a **short introduction**, which **character you'd like to play**, and **why the project intrigued you** to:

**crasherscollective@gmail.com**

Feel free to share this post with anyone who might be a great fit—we can't wait to hear from you!

++ 🔥Wenn der Metal die Hölle entfesselt... 🔥++

Ab August 2027 entsteht auf dem Gelände des Rock the Farm Langerringen  Festivals eine Horrorcomedy, die das Metal-Genre auf den Kopf stellen könnte.

Was passiert, wenn ein friedliches Heavy-Metal-Festival plötzlich zum Epizentrum einer Dämoneninvasion wird?

Genau diese Frage soll ab August 2027 auf dem legendären ROCK THE FARM-Gelände in Langerringen beantwortet werden – dort, wo jedes Jahr echte Metalheads gemeinsam feiern, soll schon bald das Grauen Einzug halten. 

Doch keine Sorge: Zwischen blutigen Monstern, höllischen Kreaturen und dem drohenden Weltuntergang bleibt reichlich Platz für rabenschwarzen Humor, absurde Situationen und jede Menge Heavy Metal.

Stellt euch vor:

Ein Festival. Hunderte Metalfans. Gitarren. Schlagzeug. Bier. Moshpits. Die lautesten Bands des Abends...

...und plötzlich öffnet sich mitten auf dem Gelände ein Tor zur Hölle.

Während Dämonen das Festival übernehmen und Chaos ausbricht, müssen ausgerechnet Musiker, Crew-Mitglieder und Besucher zusammenhalten. Denn wer glaubt, dass nur Weihwasser gegen das Böse hilft, kennt die Macht einer voll aufgedrehten Metalmeute noch nicht...

Die Macher sprechen von einer Liebeserklärung an die Metal-Szene. Wer Festivals kennt, wird unzählige Anspielungen entdecken. Wer Horror liebt, darf sich auf dämonische Kreaturen, übernatürliche Eskalationen und spektakuläre Effekte freuen. 

Und wer schwarzen Humor mag, könnte hier seinen neuen Kultfilm finden.

Eines steht jedoch schon jetzt fest:

Ab August 2027 wird auf dem ROCK THE FARM-Gelände nicht nur Metal gespielt - dort wird die Hölle ihre Tore öffnen, die Verstärker werden beben und die Nacht wird blutrot.

Vielleicht beginnt genau hier der lauteste, verrückteste und durchgeknallteste Horrorfilm, den die deutsche Metal-Szene jemals gesehen hat.

Und mit im aktuellen Team sind Menschen, die unter andrem bei folgenden Projekten vor und/oder hinter der Kamera standen: 

- LEVIZIA 
- ⁠START YOUNG 
- ⁠THE LAST TRAIN 
- ⁠DARK DAYZ 
- ⁠VHS: UNDERGROUND 1+2
- ⁠PUPPENMACHER
- ⁠WRONGFUL DEATH 
- ⁠ONG BAK 
- ⁠STREETFIGHTER: CHUN LI  
- ⁠BELLY OF THE BEAST 
- ⁠BIG GAME - DIE JAGD BEGINNT 
- ⁠DAS MEDDAILLON (mit Jackie Chan)
- ⁠MATRIX 4 (!!!) 

Und wenn du Teil davon sein willst: 

Wir suchen noch: 

👉 Metal-Statisten 

👉 Leute mit Erfahrung im Bereich Special Effects

👉 Leute, die uns hinter der Kamera aushelfen 

👉Co-Producer (inkl. rechtsgültigem Vertrag), die Teil des Projekts sein wollen!

🔥Stay tuned. Denn das ist erst der Anfang… 🔥

@Follower 
Erik Markus Schuetz Jean Rises elina.mj Christian Matthesius Sprachrohr Eisregen #Inanis KveldulF Spanky Ham 

#heavymetal #comedy #movie #Splatter #Horror #fun #specialeffects #festival

Title: The Sister

Logline: When a group of teenage girls engage in a series of pranks, one prank phone call threatens to expose the casual cruelty of girlhood. 

Shooting Date: Sunday, August 2nd

Hours: 10AM-4PM

Location: Orange ,CA

E-mail: moraleslopez@chapman.edu

Compensation: copy of film and credit are provided

JESSICA (15, LATINA)

 •A teen girl who’s an agitator through and through. She’s always ready to escalate a joke, even if it’s at the cost of someone else’s feelings. To her, empathy is laughable, and she feels the burning need to be the center of attention. 

KAYLA (16, LATINA)

   •The group's enabler. Often lacking her own opinion, Kayla sticks to whoever she views as the leader in any situation. She does as she's told out of fear of being viewed as different, even if her actions carry out hurtful consequences. 

No minors. Looking for actresses between the ages of 18-25. 

Feel free to email a headshot and reel to moraleslopez@chapman.edu

I am looking for a talented, Las Vegas-based videographer and editor for a long-term creative partnership to help scale the brand for my new startup, Reseller Bro.

To kick things off, we are producing two fully written, comedic time-travel skits that introduce the app. For this project and future others, you must have an excellent grasp of comedic timing and the ability to craft high-quality app UI motion graphics to show off the app on screen.

Beyond this initial launch, I have a massive pipeline of short-form and long-form video content lined up for the next year in Las Vegas. I am looking to find a true creative partner—whoever I vibe with best and who can execute this vision will be locked in as our go-to media creator for the entire long-term campaign.

What I will provide: "For the right person"

Pay 30–40 USD per hour + Equity package

The actor (myself)

Location (thrift store)

Full script (1 Short teaser-15 second intro video & 1 Longer ~2-minute explanation video).

Reseller Bro (functioning App.)

What I need from you:

Dynamic, fast-paced filming & editing matching a comedic, skit-style tone (For all Social Media Platforms).

Sound design (muffled thrift store background noise, tech sound effects for the app scan).

Please include links of your work, specifically any projects where you integrated app screens or UI graphics into live-action footage.

Check out the landing page and video for Reseller Bro below

[www.resellerbro.com](https://www.resellerbro.com/)

Casting Call for “Trailer Trash: The Second Helping”, a short film.

**Synopsis: **“Trailer Trash: The Second Helping” is an R-rated comedy that follows up on the wild antics of a few poor small town North Carolina rednecks going about their daily drama-filled lives. This will be the sequel to the first Trailer Trash which you can check out right now on youtube. 

[Trailer Trash](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Adts7TwPqwo&t=585s)

Genre: Slightly Obscene Redneck Comedy

Title: Trailer Trash The Second Helping

Production Type: Independent

Director: Clayton Christopher Wood

Producer: Clayton Christopher Wood

Compensation: Gas money 

**Audition Information:**

We are currently only accepting video auditions, have yours in by August 20th to be considered for a role.

**Locations**** :** Mamers, North Carolina,  

**Shooting Dates: Saturday September 19th, Sunday September 20th**

Must be available from 10:00 am. to 7:00 pm Saturday, and 11:00 to 7:00 pm on Sunday.  Keep in mind times are not exact, we may finish early some days or later on others depending on how the shoots go. 

**Meals will be provided. Main acting roles will be paid**

**Character Descriptions: **

**Dale**: 6-10 year old boy or girl, preferably with either red or brown hair who can follow directions well and must be accompanied by a parent. 

**Junior**: 6-10 year boy or girl preferably with red or brown hair who can follow directions well and must be accompanied by a parent.

**Angel**: A very attractive southern blonde female between the ages of 45 and 55 with an ample bust, who has an aura about her that seems almost Angelic. 

**Hoggymama** - Annoying elderly redneck woman at the Pig Pickin’ who constantly tells boring irrelevant stories to anyone around who will listen, and will keep raving on even after people quit listening.

**Extras: **We will need at least 10-15 extras who will be fed and compensated with gas money depending on how far they have to drive. Each extra will play a redneck at a pig pickin, and are free to come up with their own redneck costume or provide us with sizes and we can put together a costume for you to wear

If you are interested, please contact the email below or call or text me at (919) 475-0274 to receive the sides for the character. 

[Claytonwood88@gmail.com](mailto:Claytonwood88@gmail.com)

Thank you for your time! We look forward to hearing from you.

items.text:
PAID invitation to share your story for a documentary,  South Korean TV.
We are currently producing a special documentary on young generation,  especially recent UK graduates facing the tough job market.

This is a global phenomenon. 

Looking for a recent UK graduate (2024- 2025) still searching for their first career step, this documentary is exploring a challenge that defines our times: the incredible tough job market facing today's young generation. 

From South Korea to the UK, we know that millions of highly qualified young people are doing everything right - sending endless applications and navigating ghosting- yet facing unprecedented structural barriers.

Our goal is to amplify your voice and spark a conversation on how society needs to change to support your generation. 

We are looking for recent graduates based in Manchester, Nottingham,  Leeds, Midlands,  Home Counties to share their journey with us.

Filming details ;

- Format : A respectful,  cinematic look at your daily routine and interview. 

("REALITY" format)

- Time Commitment: minimum 2 days, ideally 3 days of filming in your local area and at your place.

We will come to where you are based.

- EXPECTED SHOOTINGS:

Between the 2nd and the 10th Sept 2026

- COMPENSATION: We deeply value your time and commitment,  and offer a competitive daily fee of £400.00

We want to tell this story with the utmost empathy,  dignity, and respect. 

Your perspective could help our viewers understand the true reality of entering the workforce today.

If you are open to a chat and see if this feels like a good fit for you, or if you know someone around you who could be a fit for this, please let me know your availability and we take it from there.

If you are interested in sharing your story, please send us the basic information for us to read you first.

1) your full name / age

2) University attended (Degree) / Graduation Year;

3) Your current situation ; i.e Working part time/ Unemployed/ Internship/ living with parents etc

4) How many CVs sent out.

(ie 0-50? / 50~100?/ 100 +)

5) The worst experience in job hunting .

If you could send all these via email we will read them through get back to you ,if we feel you would be a good fit for our documentary. 

I hope this doesn't sound like job interviews after all !!

How irony.....🙏

Hope to hear from you soon!

This is open until the * 5th of August 2026.

Many thanks.

Gina

www.ginamcdonaldtv.co.uk

ginamcdonaldtv@gmail.com

# 🎭 URGENT CASTING CALL – ORIS

Unfortunately, due to unforeseen circumstances, we are looking to recast the role of **Oris** in our original musical, **A Place Not Mine**.
**ORIS**

**Male | Playing Age: 18–30**

Oris is one of the main characters in the story. He is charismatic, quick-witted and full of energy, always finding a way to make people laugh. Beneath his humour, however, is someone incredibly loyal, caring and emotionally intelligent. He is the first person to welcome the new student to Novaterra and quickly becomes the heart of the friendship group.

We're looking for an actor who has:
* Strong acting ability.
* Good singing ability.
* Great comic timing.
* Warm, likeable energy and strong ensemble skills.

📍 **Please note:** We are **only considering actors based in London or the surrounding areas**, as regular rehearsals will take place in London.

**Payment:** This is currently an unpaid opportunity. However, should the production secure funding, all cast members will be paid accordingly. 
Audition

If you're interested, simply send us a message on **Instagram**.

If you'd like, you can also include a **self-tape singing any Disney song**. This is **completely optional**, but we'd love to hear your voice if you choose to send one.

We can't wait to hear from you! ✨

📩 **DM us on Instagram:** @a.place.not.mine

items.text:
🎬 It’s a wrap! 🎬

What an incredible week of filming! I honestly couldn’t be prouder of every one of our child and adult actors from our Academy and Talent Agency. From long days and night shoots to the early hours of the morning, every moment has been worth it.
In all my years on film sets, I can genuinely say I’ve never seen such respectful, hardworking and well-behaved children. That’s not me being biased, that’s me speaking as an agent, principal teacher and a mum. You have all represented yourselves, your families and our Academy so beautifully. 💜
For many of our children and adults, this was their very first professional filming experience. It isn’t always glamorous, but the confidence, resilience and memories they’ve gained are priceless.
A huge thank you to our incredible parents for your patience, support and commitment. Those long hours were yours too, and some of you even got a little behind-the-scenes glimpse of life on set. We couldn’t do this without you. 💜
This may be a wrap for now, but we’re back on set from August through to November, with even more exciting opportunities ahead for our talented Academy family.
📸 Here’s a cheeky little behind-the-scenes sneak peek! We have so much more to share, but for now we can’t give too much away… 🤫
The future is looking incredibly bright, and I couldn’t be prouder. 💜💛

#ItsAWrap #BehindTheScenes #TalentAgency #ActingAcademy #YoungActors

items.text:
BACKGROUND PERFORMERS NEEDED - Feature Film in Hamilton, ON
We’re shooting a big cinema scene for my upcoming feature film “Storytellers”, a coming-of-age story inspired by classic 1970s-80s adventure films. The scene: a packed movie theater audience reacting to a film premiere, laughing, gasping, completely swept up in the moment.

DETAILS:

 • Date: Wednesday, August 26th (morning)
 • Location: Westdale Theatre, Hamilton
 • Time commitment: approximately 3-4 hours
 • Looking for 40-50 extras to fill the seats
 • Nearly every extra will get an INDIVIDUAL CLOSE-UP reacting to the movie, not just background wide shots

COMPENSATION:

 • A meal and snacks provided on set
 • Credit as background performer in the film, including on IMDb
 • An invite to the film’s premiere later this year

This is an unpaid background role, but a great chance to be part of an independent feature film.

Interested? Comment below or send a message and we’ll get you the sign-up details. My email:
augustin.sasarman@ssdentertainment.com

Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

1. Kamil (24) – agresywny socjopata i patologiczny kłamca z przeszłością w poprawczaku, mocno zadłużony. Silny, na dopalaczach, bezwzględne spojrzenie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY 
Daty: 10.08 i 11.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

2. Adrian (27) – Interesuje się strzelectwem, jest instruktorem na strzelnicy. Zostaje postrzelony przez kolegę, gdy próbuje obezwładnić go podczas włamania.
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Dominik (28) – prowadzi spółkę zajmującą się kompleksowym montażem nowoczesnych instalacji elektrycznych, alarmów i monitoringu. Zostaje pobity. Średniej budowy ciała, nie jest silny fizycznie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4. Pracownik 2 (28) – pracownik budowlany
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

5. Sebastian (30) – prowadzi komis, karany w przeszłości za kradzieże. Skupuje kradziony sprzęt.
Data: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

6. Pracownik 1 (37) – pracownik budowlany 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

7. Konrad (39) – brat Artura. Nieporadny, z bardzo niską samooceną, wiecznie gnębiony przez brata i niedoceniany przez rodziców. Przez całe życie gromadził w sobie żal i gniew. Wysoki, szczupły, dłuższe włosy.
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Daty: 12.08 i 14.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

8. Biznesmen (45) – elegancko ubrany mężczyzna, zostaje napadnięty na ulicy. 
Daty: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9. Właściciel (48) – przedsiębiorca budowlany. Zawiadamia policję o zaginięciu pracowników i pomaga w identyfikacji. 
Daty: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Brian Espina will join our New York Fashion Week 

Brian Espina is a seasoned model and brand ambassador with experience in print advertising and hair modeling. Having begun his journey in the industry at a young age, Brian is now embracing a new chapter in his career as an over-40 model.

With confidence, experience, and a renewed passion for the industry, he continues to pursue the dreams he once had while inspiring others to believe that age is never a limitation. For Brian, dreams have no expiration date.

Thank you 🙏 to our models
Thank you to the models who are referring other models
Thank you Lord for all the blessings

🎥 Gesicht für eine TikTok-Personal-Brand gesucht
Du hast Ausstrahlung, fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl oder möchtest genau das lernen?

Für ein langfristig angelegtes Projekt suchen wir eine motivierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns eine professionelle und authentische TikTok-Personal-Brand aufbaut.

Das erwartet dich

✔ Aufbau einer eigenen Personal Brand

✔ Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team

✔ Arbeit mit einem bereits bestehenden, marktreifen Produkt

✔ Persönliche Einarbeitung und Begleitung

✔ Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Projekts

Das solltest du mitbringen

✔ Zuverlässigkeit und Motivation

✔ Freude an Social Media und Kommunikation

✔ Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen

✔ Ein sympathisches und authentisches Auftreten

Vorkenntnisse oder eine grosse Reichweite sind keine Voraussetzung.

Transparenz ist uns wichtig

Vor einer möglichen Zusammenarbeit erhältst du alle wichtigen Informationen zum Projekt und zum Ablauf. Einen bestimmten Erfolg oder ein bestimmtes Einkommen können und möchten wir nicht versprechen.

📩 Wenn dich das anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb dich jetzt mit einem kurzen Vorstellungsvideo. Wenn vorhanden, kannst du uns gerne auch deine Referenzen oder Social-Media-Kanäle mitschicken.

# Wir suchen mehrere Gesichter für TikTok-Personal-Brands

Für bereits bestehende und marktreife Produkte suchen wir **mehrere sympathische, kommunikative und zuverlässige Personen**, die gemeinsam mit uns langfristig eigene TikTok-Personal-Brands aufbauen möchten.

# **Deine Aufgaben**
* Regelmässige Aufnahme von TikTok-Videos und weiterem Short-Form-Content
* Umsetzung von vorgegebenen Skripten, Briefings und Content-Ideen
* Authentische Präsentation und Bewerbung eines bestehenden Produktes
* Aufbau einer glaubwürdigen und langfristigen Personal Brand
* Zuverlässige und kontinuierliche Content-Produktion
* Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung der Inhalte

# Das solltest du mitbringen
* Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
* Du kannst Inhalte sympathisch, natürlich und überzeugend vermitteln
* Du arbeitest zuverlässig und hältst dich an Absprachen
* Du bist offen für Feedback und kannst Vorgaben professionell umsetzen
* Du hast Interesse an Social Media, Content-Produktion und Personal Branding
* Du möchtest langfristig mit einem festen Team zusammenarbeiten
* Eine bereits vorhandene Reichweite ist nicht erforderlich

# Was dich erwartet
* Klare Skripte, Briefings und Unterstützung durch unser Team
* Eine langfristig angelegte Zusammenarbeit
* Der Aufbau eines eigenen Social-Media-Auftritts
* Die Bewerbung eines bereits bestehenden und marktreifen Produktes
* Klare Prozesse und eine enge Zusammenarbeit bei der Content-Planung
* Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung mit prozentualer Beteiligung an den durch deinen Content generierten Leads Partenaire.

## Wir möchten **mehrere TikTok-Personal-Brands parallel aufbauen** und freuen uns deshalb über Bewerbungen von unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten.

CASTING CALL – FEATURE TELEVISION DRAMA SERIES (IN DEVELOPMENT) - Lead And Featured Role
K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men

- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors

* Late 30s, 40s and 50s

* London-based applicants preferred

* Previous acting experience essential

* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review

* Casting interview

* Self-tape audition

* Character discussions and project briefing

* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops

* Sessions with experienced acting coaches

* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives

* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub

* Refreshments and facilities provided

* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

How to Apply?

Please email or DM your application including:

* Headshot

* Full Name

* Telephone Number

* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

Email: Ahmedsy_jaber@hotmail.com

CASTING CALL – FEATURE TELEVISION DRAMA SERIES (IN DEVELOPMENT) - Lead And Featured Role
K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men

- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors

* Late 30s, 40s and 50s

* London-based applicants preferred

* Previous acting experience essential

* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review

* Casting interview

* Self-tape audition

* Character discussions and project briefing

* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops

* Sessions with experienced acting coaches

* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives

* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub

* Refreshments and facilities provided

* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

* Full Name

* Telephone Number

* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

items.text: Hi all! I just wanted to introduce myself my name is Daisy ! I’m 22 and looking to get into acting! I’ve been to a drama school when I was younger and loved the idea of being the reason someone watches a tv series/ film. I’m very bubbly and outgoing. I can be very competitive but in a healthy way! I LOVEEE thrillers and end of the world movies. If you feel I would have potential or you would like me to auditions please message me or comment down below🩷🫶🏼

topComments.text: Just some general advice (if you want it) - appearance is only one of many factors in casting, and I’d be very wary of anyone who offers you opportunities just based on a selfie! Any legit casting director will generally want to see some proof of acting skills and experience - usually in the form of a showreel, but if you’re just starting out a simple self-tape of a short scene or monologue would be enough 😊 But most importantly get some training, good luck on your journey!

Firstly … watching tv doesn’t mean you’ll be good on it (just saying) 

However, get back into acting use your local theatre, acting guild or groups even talk to university’s as some students need amateurs for film production. 
Along with this take classes to sharpen skills and make connects. 
Then get professional head shots done.

Casting Call: Actors, Interactive Performers & Scare Technicians

Gallows Hill Museum & Theatre – Salem, Massachusetts / The Lost Museum Haunted Adventure

Paid Seasonal Positions
Fall Halloween Season

Gallows Hill Museum & Theatre, one of Salem’s premier Halloween attractions, is seeking talented, energetic, and dependable performers to join our cast for the upcoming fall season. We are casting for multiple short productions that blend theatrical storytelling, audience interaction, suspense, and practical effects.

Production 1: Main Stage Immersive Experience

We’re seeking versatile actors to perform in our signature immersive theatrical production about witches and ghosts.

This fast-paced 22 minute show features a single performer portraying multiple characters through rapid costume changes, dynamic storytelling, comedy, suspense, and the use of puppetry. Performers must be comfortable switching between distinct personalities while maintaining high energy throughout each performance.

Ideal candidates possess:

Strong acting and storytelling abilities
Excellent character work
Confidence performing for live audiences
Quick memorization skills
High energy
Some experience with improvisation

This role offers an exciting opportunity to showcase versatility in a truly unique theatrical experience.

Production 2: The Lost Museum

Step into the role of an eccentric museum guide as guests explore a collection of mysterious artifacts and strange curiosities…

…until everything begins to go spectacularly wrong.

Actors portraying museum guides lead guests through haunted rooms while balancing suspense, audience interaction, and improvisation. You’ll remain in character as supernatural events unfold around your tour group, creating an experience that is equal parts entertaining, immersive, and delightfully chaotic. 

When not leading tours, performers will also work as Scare Technicians, operating puppets, ghosts, practical effects, lighting cues, hidden scares, and other theatrical illusions that make the attraction come alive.

We’re seeking performers who are:

Passionate about theatre, Halloween, and immersive entertainment
Strong communicators comfortable speaking to groups
Excellent improvisers who can think on their feet
Reliable, punctual, and professional
Team players with positive attitudes
Comfortable interacting with audiences of all ages
Interested in learning backstage theatrical effects and puppet operation
Day, evening and weekend shifts are available.

Previous experience in theatre, haunted attractions, improv, museums, escape rooms, theme parks, or live entertainment is welcomed but not required. We are happy to train enthusiastic individuals with a strong work ethic and a willingness to learn.

Please submit:

Headshot (professional or recent clear photo)
Resume (if available)
A brief introduction telling us about yourself and why you’d like to join our cast
Demo reel (optional)
Video submission is also acceptable

 Email: gallowshillsalem@outlook.com for an audition appointment.

K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review
* Casting interview
* Self-tape audition
* Character discussions and project briefing
* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops
* Sessions with experienced acting coaches
* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives
* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub
* Refreshments and facilities provided
* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

How to Apply?

Please email or DM your application including:

* Headshot
* Full Name
* Telephone Number
* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

Email: Ahmedsy_jaber@hotmail.com

Serious Applicants Only!

We are moving quickly with this project and are looking for committed, reliable and professional actors who are genuinely interested in becoming part of a long-term television production.

If you know someone who would be suitable, please share this casting opportunity.

LOS ANGELES — SOUND MIXER NEEDED

Hello everybody! 
We are going to participate in the 48 hr film festival taking place this coming weekend. In case you don’t know how this works: 
On Friday evening we are getting a prompt, wich could be a prop, a character, costume or action etc, and we need to write a short script around that. Then we’ll shoot on Saturday all day and edit on Sunday.

Andrew, our director, has participated in this festival last year and really enjoyed it. There will be a screening of all films in about two weeks. 

We have most of our crew and actors who the director has worked with before and will base the script on their abilities and age-ranges.

We only need our SOUND MIXER.
You would only be needed on our shoot day on Saturday, August 1, 2026, probably from 8 AM - 8 PM (tbd). The location will be in South Pasadena with free street parking.

Gear will be provided. 

Due to the 48 hr FF regulations, nobody is permitted to get paid (and we don’t want to cheat!). Therefore, this would be a volunteer position.
If you don’t have much experience but are interested in helping out or are a film student or new to this business who needs credits, please contact us. 

We will provide breakfast, lunch and credit, of course.

We truly hope to hear from you! Join this exciting project and have fun with us! 

Best regards, 

Annette Remter (producer) and Andrew Sego (writer/director/Producer)

Open Your Heart. Change a Life.
Have you ever thought about hosting a high school exchange student?

We’re seeking caring host families who would enjoy sharing everyday life with a student from another country while learning about a new culture. It’s an incredible opportunity to build lifelong friendships and create memories that last a lifetime.

Our students come with their own spending money and medical insurance and are excited to become part of your family, attend a local high school, and experience life in America.

Time is of the essence as students prepare for the upcoming school year, and we’d love your help in making this opportunity possible.

Know someone who would make a great host family? Refer them to me! If they are approved and host a student, you’ll receive a $500 referral gift card as our thank-you.

If hosting isn’t the right fit for your family, we would truly appreciate you sharing this post. Your share could be the connection that helps a student find their perfect host family.

Message me or comment below to learn more about hosting or referring a host family! 🌎❤️

PROJECT INDIA
Lokacja zdjęć: Warszawa 

 Ilość dni zdjęciowych: 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe (w zależności od roli) - 18-19 sierpnia 🎬🎥✅

 Prawa / Usage Rights: 1 rok 

 Terytorium emisji: INDIE (Brak emisji w Polsce / Europie / UK)

 Pola eksploatacji: TV, Digital, Internet, Social Media

ROLE GŁÓWNE (HERO ROLES) — 1 000 USD / dzień z prawami 

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. REŻYSER (THE DIRECTOR) — 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 40–60 lat (typ indyjsko-brytyjski lub europejski).

 Opis: Prawdziwy twórca kinowy, lekko niewyspany, charakterystyczny.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego, wyczucie aktorskie)

2. NARZECZONY (ROMANTIC LEAD) [Gra mimiką]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Charyzmatyczny, ciepły, bardzo męski, dojrzały urok.

 Wymagania: Świetna gra emocjami i mimiką.

KATEGORIA 2: ROLE DRUGOPLANOWE  — 700 USD / dzień z prawami

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. 1st AD (1-szy Asystent Reżysera) 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–45 lat.

 Opis: Dynamiczny, głośny, ekspresyjny. Komediowy wykrzyk "CUT!". 

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

2. OPERATOR (CAMERAMAN) —

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–50 lat.

 Opis: Członek ekipy filmowej z krótką kwestią.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

3. OFIARA (VICTIM) — Scena Zombie [Gra ekspresyjna]

CALL FOR COMPOSERS: (Short Film)

Genre: Drama / Psychological Thriller

Synopsis: Driven to the breaking point by his father's violent alcoholism, a desperate teenager commits a fatal act of rebellion to save his family—only to find that the price of their freedom is a suffocating, inescapable guilt.

✨ What we are looking for ✨

We are seeking talented and passionate Film Composers to create an original score that brings the emotional depth, tension, and tragedy of this story to life.

The ideal candidate will be able to translate complex psychological themes—trauma, desperation, relief, and crushing guilt—into a powerful soundscape. Whether your style relies on subtle minimalist acoustics, haunting ambient textures, or brooding orchestral elements, we want to hear your vision!

✨ Project Details & Compensation ✨

Type: Independent Short Film
Compensation: Unpaid 
Credit: Full screen credit and official IMDb credit provided.
Perks: High-quality footage for your reel/portfolio, full festival exposure, and a collaborative environment with a dedicated creative team.

📩 How to Apply 📩

If you are interested in scoring this short film, please send us the following:

Name & Contact Information
A link to your showreel, portfolio, or Spotify/SoundCloud (please highlight tracks with dramatic or thriller tones)
A brief introduction about yourself and why this story resonates with you.

📩 Send us a DM Madhouse Productions or Creativery Arts 
📅 Deadline for Submissions: 10th August 2026

Hi all, we’re taking our ★★★★★, multi-award-nominated play Spare Room to the Edinburgh Fringe (with London previews) this summer following a critically acclaimed debut run, and we’d love to connect with fellow actors and theatre-makers while we’re there.

Whether you’re performing at the Fringe, based in Edinburgh, or just visiting, we’d love to invite you to see the show. It’s a great opportunity to meet fellow creatives, make new industry connections and hopefully start conversations about future collaborations.

We preview at The Drayton Arms (London) on 1st & 2nd August, before running 7th–22nd August at theSpace on the Mile in Edinburgh.

If you’d like to come along, please get in touch at georginahousby@gmail.com and we’d be delighted to arrange a complimentary ticket.

About the show:

Set entirely in the living room of a student house share, Spare Room follows Jodie as she leaves her troubled home in search of a fresh start. Inspired by true events, the play offers a darkly comic portrayal of student life as Jodie navigates living with a house full of testosterone-fuelled uni lads shaped by drug and alcohol culture.

What initially appears to be a comedic exploration of familiar student struggles gradually unfolds into a far darker narrative, exposing the often misogynistic and hostile nature of male group dynamics. Unafraid to confront uncomfortable truths, Spare Room delivers a nuanced insight into consent, addiction, masculinity and mental health.

Written by co-founders Georgina Housby (a consent facilitator) and Sam Dinnage, Spare Room was developed in response to the urgent need for more nuanced conversations around consent and gender dynamics. The company is partnering with Enough and Head’s Up Guys to extend the show’s impact beyond the stage, connecting audiences with meaningful support and ongoing dialogue.

Whether you’re looking to expand your network, meet other creatives, or simply enjoy new writing at the Fringe, we’d love to welcome you. Please do come and say hello after the show—we’re always keen to meet fellow actors and hear what you’re working on.

www.blueducktheatrecompany.com

@blueducktheatrecompany

Szukamy fotomodelki na sesję zdjęciowo-filmową trasa:

nr 1

Azja ( Hong Kong, Japonia ) + USA ( Hawaje, Kalifornia, Nevada, Carolina, NYC, Floryda-Miami ). Od 28 sierpnia do 16 września.

nr 2

Czerwiec 2027 ( USA-miejsca będą ustalane dopiero z końcem roku).

Wybierzemy tylko 1 fotomodelkę ponieważ mamy 1 stałą z Polski + w każdym miejscu będą dodatkowo 3 lokalne modelki.

Wymagania wobec fotomodelki:
1. Wzrost min 170 cm.
2. Dobra umiejętność jazdy na wrotkach ( 1/2 sesji krótkich będzie odbywać się na wrotkach na mieście a pozostała część nagrań na plażach. ).
3. Figura szczupła.
4. Możliwie jak najbardziej naturalny wygląd.
5. Mile widziany słowiański wygląd ( niewymagane ale będzie to na plus ).
6. Wiek kandydatki ( 18-24 ) ze względu na to że nastawiamy się na dalszą współpracę jeśli współpraca nr 1 przebiegnie prawidłowo.

Dodatkowe informacje:
* 100% kosztów pokrywamy + dieta za 20 dni + wynagrodzenie za dni nagraniowe ( 8 dni ).
* Pierwsza trasa objazdowa to 20 dni łącznie z podróżą i w tym 8 dni zdjęciowych ( każdy do 3 h ) i reszta to czas wolny.
* Selekcja będzie duża ze względu na to że potrzebujemy tylko 1 osobę i dlatego zależy nam na tym aby była to najlepsza kandydatura z możliwych. Nie potrzebujemy modelki na 1 zlecenie. Jak marka będzie zadowolona to będzie dalsza współpraca od 2027 r.
* Wszelkie informacje przekażemy w bezpośredniej korespondencji z wybranymi wstępnie kandydatkami po zapoznaniu się z portfolio kandydatki. Dlatego na początek prosimy o przesłanie tylko portfolio i tylko osoby, które spełniają powyższe wymagania.
* Będzie to okazja dla fotomodelki zdobycia wyjątkowego portfolio z uwagi na współpracę z modelkami z Azji i USA w miejscach gdzie będziemy prowadzić nagrania komercyjne dla marki Amerykańskiej (z korzeniami Polskimi).

Pozdrawiamy serdecznie

2. Dobra umiejętność jazdy na wrotkach ( 1/2 sesji krótkich będzie odbywać się na wrotkach na mieście a pozostała część nagrań na plażach. ).
3. Figura szczupła.
4. Możliwie jak najbardziej naturalny wygląd.
5. Mile widziany słowiański wygląd ( niewymagane ale będzie to na plus ).
6. Wiek kandydatki ( 18-24 ) ze względu na to że nastawiamy się na dalszą współpracę jeśli współpraca nr 1 przebiegnie prawidłowo.

Dodatkowe informacje:
* 100% kosztów pokrywamy + dieta za 20 dni + wynagrodzenie za dni nagraniowe ( 8 dni ).
* Pierwsza trasa objazdowa to 20 dni łącznie z podróżą i w tym 8 dni zdjęciowych ( każdy do 3 h ) i reszta to czas wolny.
* Selekcja będzie duża ze względu na to że potrzebujemy tylko 1 osobę i dlatego zależy nam na tym aby była to najlepsza kandydatura z możliwych. Nie potrzebujemy modelki na 1 zlecenie. Jak marka będzie zadowolona to będzie dalsza współpraca od 2027 r.
* Wszelkie informacje przekażemy w bezpośredniej korespondencji z wybranymi wstępnie kandydatkami po zapoznaniu się z portfolio kandydatki. Dlatego na początek prosimy o przesłanie tylko portfolio i tylko osoby, które spełniają powyższe wymagania.
* Będzie to okazja dla fotomodelki zdobycia wyjątkowego portfolio z uwagi na współpracę z modelkami z Azji i USA w miejscach gdzie będziemy prowadzić nagrania komercyjne dla marki Amerykańskiej (z korzeniami Polskimi).

Pozdrawiamy serdecznie

sharedPost.text:
Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 31/2026

FILMMUSIK IN PAASDORF UND SPIDER-MAN NÄCHSTER AUFTRITT.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day ist der offizielle Titel des vierten MCU-Spider-Man-Films mit Tom Holland, der in den Kinos anläuft. Der von Sony Pictures und den Marvel Studios produzierte Blockbuster setzt vier Jahre nach den Ereignissen von Spider-Man: No Way Home an und zeigt einen erwachsenen, völlig isolierten Peter Parker. 

The Stories“ ist ein internationaler Spielfilm  unter der Regie des österreichisch-ägyptischen Regisseurs Abu Bakr Shawky. Es handelt sich um ein herzerwärmendes, semi-autobiografisches Drama, das auf der wahren Liebesgeschichte seiner eigenen Eltern basiert. Mit dem Regisseur konnte Sarah Fuchs ein paar Worte wechseln. 

Das Open-Air-Filmmusikkonzert „Magic Movie Moments“  in Paasdorf fand  27. Juni 2026, am Paasdorfer Kellerrundplatz statt. Unsere Moderatorin konnte bei diesem Event ein paar Stimmen einfangen.

Sam Neill (Jurassic Park) starb vor wenigen Tagen im Alter von 78. Ihm zum Gedenken spielen wir die Musik aus seinen bekanntesten Filmen.

Mittwoch 29.7.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Betreff: Suche nach einer Wochenend-Camera-Acting-Ausbildung
Hallo,

ich suche im Raum Baden-Württemberg eine 3-monatige Camera-Acting-Ausbildung oder einen Screen-Acting-Workshop, der nur samstags und sonntags stattfindet.

Ich arbeite derzeit im Zwei-Schicht-Betrieb, deshalb kann ich nur am Wochenende teilnehmen.

Mein Budget beträgt bis 350 €.

Ich bin Anfänger und suche einen Kurs für Anfänger als Hobby, um die Grundlagen des Camera Actings zu lernen und erste Erfahrungen vor der Kamera zu sammeln.

Falls Sie einen passenden Kurs anbieten, freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Nachricht.

Vielen Dank!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Rembo Lakatos

A L C A L I N E HORROR
ambient electronic, happy ambient music, deep space ambient, cinematic ambient soundscape, modular synth ambient, eurorack ambient music, happy trap ambient, uplifting ambient music, atmospheric electronic music, meditation ambient music, sci fi ambient soundscape, modular synthesizer music, space ambient soundtrack, experimental ambient music, deep ambient textures, relaxing ambient music, cosmic ambient music, electronic ambient soundscape, ambient space journey, modular ambient soundscape, Didier Junk
These instrumental compositions combine ambient electronic textures, deep space soundscapes, and subtle trap-inspired harmonic movement, creating an atmosphere that feels both peaceful and uplifting while remaining cinematic and immersive.
The music moves slowly at 56–58 BPM, allowing each sound to breathe within wide and spacious sonic environments. Instead of traditional percussion, the rhythmic pulse emerges from delicate telemetry beeps and subtle electronic signals, echoing like distant communications drifting through the silence of space.
The sonic palette is built from pure sine layers, marine noise textures, and immense cathedral reverbs, creating a floating and weightless atmosphere. Long tape-delay echoes stretch tones across vast sonic horizons, reinforcing the feeling of endless cosmic distance.
Occasionally, faint French whispers and calm radio-style speech appear like fragments of distant transmissions, adding a subtle human presence to the expansive soundscape.
While the overall aesthetic remains serene and atmospheric, ALCALINE – Happy Trap introduces moments of light, warmth, and quiet happiness within the ambient environment. The music evokes the feeling of peaceful exploration, optimism, and calm wonder, as if drifting through a tranquil region of the cosmos.

sharedPost.text:
Et si la prochaine rencontre changeait une création… ou le début d'une aventure ? 🍃

La Compagnie Les Ours de Laine ouvre ses portes à des artistes du mouvement : danseurs·ses, circassien·nes, acrobates, cascadeurs·ses, mimes, marionnettistes, interprètes de théâtre physique… et toutes celles et ceux qui aiment raconter par le corps et donner de la voix.

Une matinée de recherche, de training, de partage et de rencontres, en vue de nos prochaines créations et celles en cours.

📍 Paris – début septembre 2026
📩 Candidatures jusqu'au 27 août 2026 (CV + vidéo de présentation ou bande-démo).

➡️ théâtre.physique.contemporain@gmail.com

Si cette annonce peut parler à quelqu'un de votre entourage, n'hésitez pas à la partager. 🌿
